VI.description: Headless DQMH Create RT Tester. Creates the Real-Time API tester of ONE DQMH module in the ACTIVE project by calling Delacor's own scripting VIs as STATIC subVIs - the chain Delacor's Real-Time Tools\5CCreate RT Tester.vi runs behind its dialog\2C with no dialog and no keystroke.\0A\0AChain\3A lvdqmh_pick_event.vi with an empty Event Name (parse\2C pick the module by NAME\2C close the other modules) -> lvdqmh_find_testers.vi (Find Tester on Disk.vi and Find RT Tester on Disk.vi) -> Scripter - Create RT Tester.vi -> lvdqmh_close_modules.vi. Delacor's menu VI parses with Allowable Module Type = Both\2C which is Parse's default\2C so Singleton and Cloneable modules are both offered.\0A\0AWHY ONE HIERARCHY. Module Info carries thirteen refnums that LabVIEW releases when the top-level VI that opened them stops\2C so the parse and the scripter must run under one top-level VI.\0A\0ADRY RUN BY DEFAULT. Script? FALSE parses and reports only. Scripting also needs the module found\2C its API tester found\2C NO RT tester yet\2C no locked and no unsaved module\2C and no error. Tester Found?\2C RT Tester Found? and RT Tester Path report what the finders saw. Not found is not an error\3A Module Index -1. Scripted? says whether the scripter was called.\0A\0ATHE SCRIPTER HAS TWO MODALS and both are gated off here\3A a One Button Dialog when an RT tester already exists\2C and one when the API tester is not beside the module library. A modal stops LabVIEW's gRPC service\2C so the caller refuses both cases by name as well. The scripter is never handed an incoming error.\0A\0ARequires DQMH installed\2C a project OPEN AND ACTIVE in the IDE\2C and lvdqmh_pick_event.vi\2C lvdqmh_find_testers.vi and lvdqmh_close_modules.vi loaded. Generated by LabVIEWMCP\3B the Delacor VIs it calls belong to the user's DQMH installation and are not shipped with it.

FreeLabel.comment: Scripts only when Script? is TRUE
